# Credits

Everything not listed here is hand-written code: all graphics (ground,
walls, water, tanks, explosions, badges, menus, the HUD) are drawn in code
on the canvas, and all other sounds and the level-start tune are made in
code with the Web Audio API (`audio.js`). There are no fonts, images or
music files.

## Sound effects (shipped in `sounds/`)

Generated by the author with ChatGPT on 2026-11-01.

| File | Used for |
|---|---|
| `player_cannon_01.wav` | the player fires (`playerShot`) |
| `enemy_cannon_01.wav` | an enemy fires (`enemyShot`) |
| `brick_impact_01.wav` | a bullet hits a brick wall (`brickHit`) |
| `brick_destroy.wav` | the hit that breaks a brick (`brickDestroy`) |
| `tank_explosion_02.wav` | a tank blows up (`explosion`) |
| `engine_loop.wav` | the player's engine, looped (originally `tank_engine_moving.wav`) |

License: made by the author with ChatGPT for this game. Under OpenAI's
terms of use the output belongs to the user, including for commercial use.
No third-party sound libraries or recordings are used.
